opening hours tues & thurs 2.15pm to 5.30pm we welcome to our faith community baby eoin sheehan, cluin , allihies who was christened last weekend. god bless him and his family . allihies parish : harvest mass – bring your produce! please bring fresh produce from your garden or local market to our harvest mass on saturday 17th october . all offerings will be placed at the altar. let’s give thanks together for the blessings of the season! allihies parish – mass for the deceased 2025 –2026 : our annual mass for the dead will take place on saturday, 08th november at 10:00am in cahermore church . all parishioners and friends are warmly invited to attend. allihies parish : remembrance altar – month of the holy souls throughout november, parishioners are invited to bring a photo of a departed loved ones to place on our new remembrance altars in allihies & cahermore churches. this special space will be available all month as we prayerfully remember and honour those who have gone before us . "eternal rest grant unto them, o lord." garnish gaa club night : everyone who has played, coached, volunteered, supported, or helped garnish gaa over the years is warmly inv ited to a club night at o’neill’s on saturday 31 october. enjoy finger food, music, and a bit of craic as we celebrate and thank all who have contributed to the club. music starts at 9pm. all welcome! allihies men’s shed is back for its winter programme! join us every tues from 7:30pm & thurs from 12 noon to 3:30pm at back road, allihies (p75 v049). enjoy crafts, restoration projects, tea, coffee, & a chat. everyone is we lcome come along & connect with the community. find us on facebook: allihies men’s shed. there will be a prayer gathering in the nun's chapel of the sacred heart church castletownbere each thursday morning after 10 a.m. mass - please join us for some praise, worship, singing and prayer. followed by a cup of tea, scone and a chat. communal first saturday coach to knock on the 28th of nov. share our lady’s messages of fatima at the first saturdays conference in knock. a wonderful opportunity for all first saturday participants to meet together in prayer, in order to meet our lady promise of peace in the world. a coach will be leaving caherciveen stopping at glen beigh, milltown, castlemaine, farranfore, abbeyfeale and newcastlewest, fr marius has put to gether a programme of speakers to include fr jamie twohig, fr leon (medjugorje) fr philip kemmy, fr john keane, plus others. holy mass is at 3pm, confession and ado ration. the estimated cost per seat on the coach is 40 euro. cars seats can be available locally to share a lift to the designated stopping points for the coach. further details available fro m your local coordinator. name margaret sullivan, tel
